name: Activity
short: Chat and voice XP, activity stats, leaderboards and LWD$ rewards.
description: One cog for server activity: chat and voice XP with levels and level roles, message, reaction and voice-time stats, a single leaderboard with a type picker, a combined rank card, top-message roles, and Economy LWD$ rewards for level milestones and leaderboard places. XP boosters bought in the Economy cog multiply XP. Replaces the Leveling and ActivityStats cogs and keeps their data.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: Activity loaded! It reuses existing Leveling and ActivityStats data. Unload those cogs first. Use `/rank`, `/leaderboard` and `/activity` after syncing slash commands; settings are in the `/control` panel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, display names, per-server chat and voice XP, per-user level-up announcement preferences, message IDs mapped to author and channel IDs, per-user and per-channel message counts, per-message reaction counts, per-user received reaction counts, per-user voice time and active voice session start times, plus server settings such as ignored channels and roles, level roles, top-message roles and reward settings. It does not store message content or voice audio. Administrators can clear stats with `[p]activity reset` or turn tracking off in the control panel.
